text: # Campaign 5: pinned Muse Spark weights + DFlash2 draft + the 062126_256k trace corpus into one HF cache on the node's NVMe
# (refs/main written = the pins, for offline loads). HF token on the node host only, never in a container.
export CORPUS_REV=8fecd2fc56694469f758f0afbbb6335ad3043740   # the shared hub's main for the 256k corpus (InferenceX pins no revision)
echo "[dl] $(date -u +%T) start; hub $HUB; huggingface_hub $($PYDL -c 'import huggingface_hub as h; print(h.__version__)')"
for repo, rev, kind in items:
p = snapshot_download(repo, revision=rev or None, repo_type=kind, cache_dir=hub, max_workers=16)
idx = [f for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")]
want = set(json.load(open(os.path.join(p, idx[0])))["weight_map"].values()) if idx else set()
missing = [f for f in want if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, f))]
d = os.path.join(hub, ("datasets--" if kind == "dataset" else "models--") + repo.replace("/", "--"), "refs")
n = sum(1 for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors"))
print(f"[dl] ok {repo}@{rev[:10]} ({kind}): {n} shards, {len(files)} entries, {time.time()-t:.0f} s -> refs/main pinned", flush=True)
# Smoke and before/after measurements for musespark-c1-p90-sa (README item 8: full AgentX at C1 and GSM8K, before and
# after the campaign). Serves the tree in the container as Arbor builds the launch (arbor/frameworks/sglang.py:
# python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path M --served-model-name M --host 0.0.0.0 --port P <server_flags>, with the
# config's server_env and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpus>, no HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES: arbor/frameworks/base.py), on a fresh
# server; runs the pack's bench_agentx.sh (the AgentX replay, DURATION s) and then GSM8K (sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k);
# stops that server (its own process group only).
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>      e.g.  before 3600 1319 | after 3600 1319 | smoke 600 200
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='tree %H %s'; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | head -20" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt"
cfg, envf, serve, gpus, port, dur, outc = sys.argv[1:8]
env = dict(c["server_env"]); env["DURATION"] = dur; env["ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = gpus
for k, v in env.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
log "$TAG: tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); server on GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX ${DUR}s; GSM8K $NQ"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL server died"; tail -30 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL not healthy after 40 min"; tail -20 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "pid=\$(pgrep -f 'sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT ' | head -1); [ -n \"\$pid\" ] && kill -TERM -- -\$(ps -o pgid= -p \$pid | tr -d ' ') 2>/dev/null; sleep 30; \
for p in \$(pgrep -f 'sglang'); do grep -qa 'ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPUS' /proc/\$p/environ 2>/dev/null && kill -9 \$p; done; true"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c ". $OUT_C/server.env; export PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_ID MODEL_NAME=$MODEL_ID CONCURRENCY=1 NUM_PROMPTS=320 \
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s: $(grep -a '^\[bench_agentx\] p90_intvty' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
# the bench reads the corpus from the Hub (as CI): record the revision it used (the pin is 8fecd2fc)
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd /tmp && timeout 5400 python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions $NQ --port $PORT --parallel 64" > "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" 2>&1
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ) rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s: $(grep -aiE 'accuracy|invalid|latency' "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" | tail -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
# Provision the node for musespark-c1-p90-sa (campaign 5). Idempotent; run on the GPU node through ctrl/. Steps:
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, other users' containers listed (never touched)
#   2. the CI image by digest (anonymous pull: the user's Docker Hub token has expired)
#   3. Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test from the archive (plain tree + a local git commit), our pack and config
#   5. the HF cache on NVMe: model, draft and corpus at their pins (dl.sh), every shard resolving
#   6. the container: the NVMe hub at /hf-hub, InferenceX, Arbor, sessions
#   7. stack versions; the SGLang tree (workspace_root) clean at its HEAD; aiter/flydsl paths into the config
#   8. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX's install_agentic_deps)
#   9. ruppell for the profiler skill (not fatal)
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"
*"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST";; *) die "image digest mismatch";; esac
git -C "$ARBOR" init -q && git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh add -A \
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -m "AMD-AGI/Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test $ARBOR_SHA (archive)" || die "Arbor git"
python3 -m venv "$VENV" && "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && "$PY" -m pip install -q pyyaml claude-agent-sdk || die "venv"
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
python3 -c "import sglang, torch; print(\"sglang:\", sglang.__version__, sglang.__file__); print(\"torch:\", torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email >/dev/null || { git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email arbor@local; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.name Arbor; }"
# The image ships its SGLang tree with modified tracked files (the image's own state, 3 files at c722c0a1). Commit them as
# a baseline, so Arbor's diffs start from the code as shipped; the list and the diff go to the logs.
log "image's SGLang tree as shipped has $(echo "$dirty" | wc -l) modified tracked files: $(echo "$dirty" | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' ') (diff: logs/image_sglang_tree.diff)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd $WORKSPACE_ROOT && git add -u && git commit -q -m 'baseline: working-tree changes as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG@$IMAGE_DIGEST'" || die "baseline commit"
log "workspace $WORKSPACE_ROOT at $(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-90)"
pk = [e for e in cfg.get("editable_packages", []) if e.get("name") not in ("aiter", "flydsl")]
path = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip() else ""
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"

[ -z "$(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain)" ] && log "InferenceX still clean at $(git -C "$INFX" rev-parse --short HEAD)" || log "WARNING InferenceX tree changed: $(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c "import sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k" 2>/dev/null && log "GSM8K tool present (sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k)" || log "WARNING sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k not importable"
